vendors.enrichHowTo: Neo4j has no table or column comment object, so there is no bulk description statement. Put business meaning in Aura Agent tool descriptions and in few-shot examples for Text2CypherRetriever. Build an Aura Agent evaluation dataset with expected answers to test changes.

bulkSnippet.code:
# Few-shot examples for Text2CypherRetriever (not a schema comment; Neo4j has none)
examples = [
  "USER INPUT: 'Which actors starred in the Matrix?' "
  "QUERY: MATCH (p:Person)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie) WHERE m.title = 'The Matrix' RETURN p.name"
]
retriever = Text2CypherRetriever(driver=driver, llm=llm,
  neo4j_schema=neo4j_schema, examples=examples)

vendors.enrichHowTo: Write rdfs:label and rdfs:comment on classes and properties, because Voicebox reads them. Load them in bulk with stardog data add and a Turtle file. Add 5 to 50 stored queries, each with a system:voiceboxQuestion field, as few-shot examples.

notes.topic: Neo4j LLM Knowledge Graph Builder (lead: schema and descriptions from documents)
notes.text: Partly confirmed. It is a Neo4j Labs project (Apache-2.0, not in the supported product lineup) that extracts an entity graph from documents with LLMs; its 'Get Schema From Text' option suggests a schema from pasted text, RDF ontologies or a Cypher/GQL schema. The pages describe no description generation and no evaluation.

Confirmed as an experimental Labs repo with datasets, evaluation notebooks and fine-tuning notebooks (folders: functional_cypher and synthetic_*_demodbs). The Hugging Face dataset neo4j/text2cypher-2025v1 is Apache-2.0 with 10K to 100K rows, and its card gives no source or intended use. These are datasets and notebooks, not an eval service.

Refuted as a product feature. The use-case index has no lineage or catalog page. The Metadata Management page mentions lineage only in customer and partner videos (University of Washington, Adaptive), as a modeling pattern.

notes.topic: Neo4j Aura Agent (not in leads, found during check)
notes.text: Aura Agent was announced generally available on 2026-02-03, with Cypher Template, Similarity Search and Text2Cypher tools, a REST endpoint and a read-only MCP server. The docs describe agent evaluations (datasets up to 50 questions, five metrics) with no preview label; the GA blog does not mention them.

notes.topic: Stardog Voicebox generating mappings and descriptions (lead)
notes.text: Partly confirmed. Voicebox for Designer needs a Voicebox-enabled endpoint and lists 'Automated Ontology Generation' that maps data sources to ontology concepts with human review. AI-written descriptions are not documented; the Designer bulk description edit is manual, and the dev guide says Voicebox API access is limited.

sources.t: Voicebox: Ontology Maintenance and Data Mapping

notes.text: Refined. 'virtual add' registers a mapping file and 'virtual import' copies mapped data into Stardog; neither imports mapping files as metadata. Relational sources with a built-in schema get automatic R2RML direct mapping, SMS2 is the recommended syntax, and release notes say SMS1 support was removed in 11.0.0 (2025-01-22) although the virtual graphs page still names SMS as the default.

Partly confirmed, through coding agents and not an in-product generator. The 12 RelationalAI Agent Skills include rai-ontology, which builds ontologies from Snowflake tables or local data, and the tutorial tells you to review the generated files in model/. The docs home calls the product a 'decision intelligence platform'; RAI_QUERY_MODEL is Preview and Cortex agent deployment is early access.

sources.t: Go further with a coding agent (tutorial)

notes.topic: data.world ownership and AI Context Engine (lead)
notes.text: The data.world home page shows the banner 'data.world is now part of ServiceNow!' with no date. The name 'AI Context Engine' appears nowhere on the data.world pages and docs fetched, so it is Unverified. The docs name the AI assistant Archie.

Confirmed as Archie Enrich, in Public Preview for Enterprise customers. It drafts descriptions for tables, columns, glossary terms and collections, marks output '[Archie suggestion]', and generates up to 50 descriptions at once in bulk mode. SQL generation and research-question generation are beta, and the FAQ says customer data is not used to train the model.

sources.t: Enriching catalog resources in bulk using Archie

notes.text: Confirmed. PATCH /v0/metadata/resources/bulk/{owner} updates up to 25 resources per call, and the bulk create endpoint has the same limit; the reference lists no rate limits. The MCP server can edit descriptions, tags and custom properties, and Excel bulk upload exists in the Catalog Toolkit.

sources.t: data.world MCP server for AI assistants

notes.text: Partly confirmed. The system collects lineage automatically from supported systems through collectors, and users can add manual relationships. The docs do not say whether lineage is column-level, so the lineage level is 0 under the column-level definition.

Partly confirmed. AI FDE has an Ontology editing mode for 'creating or updating the objects, links, and actions', needs AIP enabled, and recommends Global Branching. The docs show no beta or GA label and do not name object types or descriptions.

Confirmed. AIP Evals tests AIP Logic, AIP Chatbot and code-authored functions with built-in, LLM-as-judge or custom evaluators, and test cases come from manual entry or Ontology object sets. A 'Generate evals' button exists for eligible Logic functions, and the docs show no status label; AIP Chatbot Studio is the new name of AIP Agent Studio.

notes.text: Partly confirmed. Data Lineage is a dataset graph with ancestors and descendants, and its column feature only finds datasets that share a column name. Workflow Lineage adds property provenance across Ontology objects, functions, actions and apps; No column-level lineage found in the docs.
